title: Provide static Polars runtime wheels for Linux and Windows x86_64
description: Build Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64 CPython 3.14t polars-runtime-32 wheels through .github/workflows/build-wheels.yml rather than compiling Polars in local development environments. Publish the wheels to the polars-bin release, then update pyproject.toml and uv.lock so both platforms select the prebuilt assets.
design: Extend the existing wheel-build matrix and preserve the explicit manylinux compatibility policy for Linux.
acceptance_criteria: The GitHub Actions workflow builds and smoke-tests Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64 CPython 3.14t wheels, publishes both to the polars-bin release, and pyproject.toml plus uv.lock select those wheels without invoking a local Cargo build.
notes: Implemented local workflow support for Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64. Linux uses ubuntu-24.04 with a manylinux_2_28 wheel assertion; Windows uses windows-2025 with a win_amd64 assertion. Both smoke-test the built wheel, upload an artifact, and honor publish_release. Validation passed with PyYAML, matrix assertions, actionlint 1.7.12, and git diff --check. Hosted build/publish and dependency lock updates remain pending because the workflow is not on GitHub and this checkout has no authenticated GitHub session.

title: Provide a static Polars runtime wheel for Linux ARM64
description: Build the missing Linux ARM64 static polars-runtime-32 wheel through the repository GitHub Actions workflow rather than compiling Polars in the local development environment. Publish or otherwise expose the wheel at the dependency URL used by pyproject.toml, then update pyproject.toml and uv.lock so Linux ARM64 selects it.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml and uv.lock select a compatible prebuilt polars-runtime-32 wheel on Linux ARM64, and uv sync does not invoke Cargo.
notes: Implemented and committed the GitHub Actions build path in ce3cde7. The workflow now builds macOS ARM64 and Linux ARM64 CPython 3.14t wheels, applies the manylinux_2_28 compatibility tag on Linux, smoke-tests each wheel, uploads artifacts, and can publish to the polars-bin release when publish_release is enabled. Hosted execution remains pending because this checkout has no GitHub CLI authentication and no push was authorized. After publishing the ARM64 asset, add its release URL to pyproject.toml and regenerate uv.lock.

title: Fix invalid syntax in Kusto compiler
description: Hql/Compiler/Kusto.py has a pre-existing incomplete expression at line 228 (out equals top plus) that prevents repository-wide compileall and may block test collection. Repair the implementation without changing unrelated compiler behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Hql/Compiler/Kusto.py compiles under the supported Python version and relevant Kusto compiler tests pass.
